description: MoE-Aware RL Optimization project-local triage rules.
hard_gates: Queue row is not a card.
Survey mention is recall evidence, not paper evidence.
No original paper PDF/HTML brief, no formal L1 card.
Formal L1 cards in notes/ root must pass scripts/autoresearch.py validate before being reported as complete.
select_rules: 针对 MoE 路由特性设计的 RL objective、importance weighting、clipping 与梯度估计。
router-aware policy optimization、routing replay / correction 及 router / expert 更新规则。
maybe_rules: 与当前 lens 直接相关但尚无原文机制证据的论文，先 queue / review。
move_elsewhere_rules: 仅使用 MoE backbone、没有结构相关算法或证据的 RL 应用。
